title: Logarithmic Mixing of Random Walks on Dynamical Random Cluster Models
summary: We study random walks on dynamically evolving graphs, where the environment is given by a time-dependent subset of the edges of an underlying graph. Concretely, following the recently introduced framework of Lelli and Stauffer, we consider a random walk interacting with a dynamical random-cluster environment, in which edges are updated with rate $μ>0$ according to Glauber dynamics with parameters $p$ and $q$, and the walker moves at rate 1 but may only traverse edges that are present at the time of the move.
